retained_contracts.contract: Exactly TextStats, count_text(text, *, strip_bom=True), count_file(path, *, strip_bom=True); immutable equal-by-value nonnegative integer fields excluding bool; TypeError/ValueError construction behavior; silent whole-input APIs, no range/export additions.

CRLF one terminator; CR/LF logical boundaries; each terminator contributes one line, nonempty final segment one, no trailing phantom, empty zero. U+0085/U+2028/U+2029 do not terminate lines; str.split Unicode whitespace determines words independently.
Remove exactly one complete-input leading U+FEFF by default, preserve second/interior BOMs; --keep-bom/False retain all. Normalize once before numbering and never normalize the selected text again.

Read complete bytes and strict UTF-8 decode before selection/counting, preserving terminators; bytes after END can still fail. Close owned handles on success/failure, retain API OSError subclasses/UnicodeDecodeError, silent no partial result and unchanged inputs.

Exactly one named input, recognized retained options before/after input until --, no abbreviations; help succeeds without acquisition. Exact lines=<N> words=<N> newline, success 0/empty stderr; input failures 1, usage 2, failures empty stdout/useful identifying stderr/no traceback; validation precedes access.

Literal - is currently a named file. Stdin remains pending; future stdin ownership, complete byte EOF/strict locale-independent decode, no-close policy and ./- named-file escape remain planned independently of format removal.

At most one spaced/equal --lines START:END; positive ordered inclusive one-based ASCII decimal endpoints with leading zeros, no size cap/interpreter guard limitation. All invalid/missing/repeated classes fail before access. Preserve logical segments/terminators, available subset beyond END, empty beyond START, blank/mixed/final/Unicode/exposed-BOM semantics, both spellings/option placements and whole-input fallback.

Accurate runnable delivered docs, nonempty independently discovered unit/integration product suites separate from workflow fixtures, allowlisted source package and actual isolated extracted-module execution, unchanged API and input bytes. Python 3.11+ standard library; no new performance/streaming/dependency/release obligation.
